uniform_proved_results: Cyclic TPP size bound for every finite group of class at most two
Subgroup TPP size bound for 2-groups with an abelian subgroup of index two
Smallest cyclic-TPP 2-group counterexample has center-disjoint cyclic factors, pairwise generation, ratio exactly2, and cyclic orders each at least4
finite_result: All cyclic TPP triples in every finite2group of order<=256 have order product<=group order. Hence L034 Conjecture3.3 holds for hypertope groups through2^11.
scope_limit: The general higher-class cyclic TPP inequality and full hypertope order conjecture remain unresolved in this work.
